title: The Lord's Supper and the Betrayal

questions.question: When Jesus had finished all these sayings, He told His disciples that after two days the Passover was coming, and what else would happen?
options: The Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified
He will be crowned King in Jerusalem
He will drive out the Romans
The temple will be suddenly destroyed by fire
questions.correctAnswer: The Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:2 (ESV): "You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified."

questions.question: While Jesus was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, what did a woman pour on His head as He reclined at table?
options: An alabaster flask of very expensive ointment
A jar of fresh water from the Jordan
A mixture of myrrh and aloe
Pure olive oil mixed with ashes
questions.correctAnswer: An alabaster flask of very expensive ointment
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:7 (ESV): "a woman came up to him with an alabaster flask of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he reclined at table."

questions.question: Why were the disciples indignant when the woman poured the ointment on Jesus?
options: They said, "For this could have been sold for a large sum and given to the poor."
They said, "She is unclean, being a sinner."
They said, "It stains His garments."
They said, "It is unlawful to pour ointment before Passover."
questions.correctAnswer: They said, "For this could have been sold for a large sum and given to the poor."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:8-9 (ESV): "And when the disciples saw it, they were indignant, saying, 'Why this waste? For this could have been sold for a large sum and given to the poor.'"

questions.question: What did Judas Iscariot ask the chief priests in order to betray Jesus to them?
options: "What will you give me if I deliver him over to you?"
"Will you promise to spare me and my family?"
"Are you the true rulers of Israel?"
"Do you swear that you will not kill him?"
questions.correctAnswer: "What will you give me if I deliver him over to you?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:14-15 (ESV): "Then one of the twelve, whose name was Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said, 'What will you give me if I deliver him over to you?'"

questions.question: How much did the chief priests pay Judas for his betrayal?
options: Thirty pieces of silver
Fifty talents of gold
A hundred denarii
Ten copper coins
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:15 (ESV): "And they paid him thirty pieces of silver."

questions.question: When Jesus said that one of the twelve who had dipped his hand in the dish with Him would betray Him, what did Judas ask?
options: "Is it I, Rabbi?"
"Lord, how could you say this?"
"Who will do this terrible thing?"
"Is it Peter?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:25 (ESV): "Judas, who would betray him, answered, 'Is it I, Rabbi?' He said to him, 'You have said so.'"

questions.question: During the Last Supper, what did Jesus say as He broke the bread and gave it to His disciples?
options: "Take, eat; this is my body."
"This bread is the manna of Moses."
"Eat, for the journey is long."
"This is my flesh which you must consume daily."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:26 (ESV): "Now as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and after blessing it broke it and gave it to the disciples, and said, 'Take, eat; this is my body.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the cup of the fruit of the vine that He gave them?
options: "For this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins."
"This cup is the new law given to Israel."
"This wine will make you drunk with the Spirit."
"This is the cup of wrath for my enemies."
questions.correctAnswer: "For this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:28 (ESV): "for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins."

questions.question: Jesus foretold that Peter would deny Him three times before what happened?
options: Before the rooster crows
Before the sun rises
Before the Roman horn sounds
Before the Passover lamb is slain
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:34 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'Truly, I tell you, this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.'"

questions.question: In Gethsemane, Jesus fell on His face and prayed: "My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless,..."
options: "...not as I will, but as you will."
"...but your anger is righteous."
"...yet I must save them all."
"...but I will endure the pain for them."
questions.correctAnswer: "...not as I will, but as you will."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:39 (ESV): "And going a little farther he fell on his face and prayed, saying, 'My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as you will.'"

questions.question: What sign did Judas use to show the crowd which man was Jesus?
options: He came up to Jesus and kissed Him
He threw his cloak around Jesus' shoulders
He pointed a sword at Jesus
He washed Jesus' feet
questions.correctAnswer: He came up to Jesus and kissed Him
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:48-49 (ESV): "Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, 'The one I will kiss is the man; seize him.' And he came up to Jesus at once and said, 'Greetings, Rabbi!' And he kissed him."

questions.question: When one of Jesus' companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, what did Jesus tell him?
options: "Put your sword back into its place. For all who take the sword will perish by the sword."
"Strike again, but do not kill."
"Only defend yourselves if they attack first."
"This sword is not large enough for this crowd."
questions.correctAnswer: "Put your sword back into its place. For all who take the sword will perish by the sword."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:52 (ESV): "Then Jesus said to him, 'Put your sword back into its place. For all who take the sword will perish by the sword.'"

questions.question: Before Caiaphas and the council, what finally caused the high priest to tear his robes and declare that Jesus uttered blasphemy?
options: Jesus said: "From now on you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven."
Jesus claimed he would tear down the temple and rebuild it.
Jesus said he was born of a virgin.
Jesus cursed the high priest in the name of God.
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus said: "From now on you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:64-65 (ESV): "...But I tell you, from now on you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven. Then the high priest tore his robes and said, 'He has uttered blasphemy...'"

questions.question: While Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, three times people accused him of being with Jesus. How did Peter respond the third time?
options: He invoked a curse on himself and swore, "I do not know the man."
He wept and ran from them.
He drew a dagger and threatened them.
He said, "You are mistaken, I am from Judea."
questions.correctAnswer: He invoked a curse on himself and swore, "I do not know the man."
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:74 (ESV): "Then he began to invoke a curse on himself and to swear, 'I do not know the man.' And immediately the rooster crowed."

questions.question: What did Peter do when he remembered the saying of Jesus?
options: He went out and wept bitterly
He surrendered to the Roman guards
He sought out Judas to punish him
He went back into the courtyard and preached boldly
questions.correctAnswer: He went out and wept bitterly
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:75 (ESV): "And Peter remembered the saying of Jesus, 'Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.' And he went out and wept bitterly."

key_verse_text: "for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins."
